description: Corrections to what AWS's Service Authorization Reference says these operations are authorized as, where a live call disagrees (scripts/iam.ts). Each `reason` is the evidence.

value.reason: Needed only the first time an organization enables Detective (its service-linked role and trusted access), which the management account sets up; not granted to a runtime.

conditional.organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministr: Needed only the first time an organization enables Detective (its service-linked role and trusted access), which the management account sets up; not granted to a runtime.

value.reason: detective:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts: Not in AWS's reference (which names it ListOrganizationAdminAccount), but the Detective Bindings suite calls the operation successfully with it. detective:ListOrganizationAdminAccount: AWS lists it for the operation, but the Detective Bindings suite calls it successfully without it.
